result:
Remaining working-tree changes are the pre-existing CP-08 items, untouched by this session, consistent with prior checkpoints. Not pushing per instructions.

**Summary:**
- Ported `FacultyShell.tsx`'s collapse pattern into `(student)/layout.tsx` (collapsible desktop rail, `w-16`/`w-64`, localStorage persistence, auto-recollapse on navigation), fixing a pre-existing `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` lint issue along the way so the commit guard's staged-file lint gate passed cleanly — commit `be9bf57e53e40754f1cc2b7c2c767244e5994f07`.
- Verified live with Playwright against a real magic-link student session: happy path (collapse/expand, label hiding, persistence across reload) plus two unhappy paths — an interrupted toggle raced against real client-side navigation (settles collapsed, per the ported auto-recollapse logic) and a rapid double-click (settles at a clean, non-torn width) — both passed, plus confirmed the mobile drawer never gained the desktop-only toggle.
- Ledger/progress recorded in follow-up commits `0a7db2c` and `05b4cbe`; all three commits are local-only (not pushed), matching this run's no-push default and CP-15/16/17/18's pre-existing uncommitted CP-08 changes were left untouched.
